response.rationale: C1 is the strongest composite diagnosis: it names NBCCS and directly specifies the SUFU etiology demonstrated by the germline splice-site mutation plus somatic loss of the trans allele. R3 is the same syndrome but stops at the generic label, while R5 only gives the histologic tumor subtype and cannot account for germline inheritance, distribution, or meningioma.

rejected.why: Identifies only the infundibulocystic BCC histologic pattern; it omits the SUFU germline mutation, family history, vulvar/facial distribution, and associated meningioma, so it is incomplete as the overall diagnosis.
